Boundaries.Name: cluster-scan-page-recovery
Boundaries.Contract: The public page starts its failure-only owner before checkpoint preflight. Recovery shares retry history through metadata, capability probes, pinned sends, cursor construction, reply cleanup and discovery completion. Recovered retirement is internal.

Boundaries.Name: cluster-scan-page-core
Boundaries.Contract: Validate and copy the checkpoint, parse legacy SCAN, and certify the pass inside the caller's page owner. Pinned transport and metadata never publish a second final error.
